event_chain.summary: Actor claims customer records and posts free sample

summary: On June 3, 2026 a threat actor using the handle "2019" claimed on an underground forum to have obtained customer records from Sydney-based travel agency FirstClass.com.au, including names, email addresses, IP addresses, account status and preferred airport. A free sample showed mostly names and emails. FirstClass had not responded publicly as of June 9.
